name: uams-web/uamswp-shortcodes-ui
description: Useful shortcodes for UAMS websites, which can be added using the Shortcake shortcode UI.

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the unit suite (the same as test:unit).
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the Pest suite. WordPress functions are mocked with Brain Monkey, so no WordPress install or database is needed.
scripts-descriptions.stan: Run PHPStan at the level phpstan.neon.dist sets.
scripts-descriptions.test:pint: Check formatting with Pint without changing files.
scripts-descriptions.lint:floor: Parse every file the download ships with the PHP that runs the script; run it under PHP 8.2 with LINT_PHP set to that binary.
